explanation: David Prowse, a British bodybuilder, wore the suit on set, but his lines were replaced by Jones's voice. Jones went uncredited in the 1977 film.

claims.text: James Earl Jones voiced Darth Vader in Star Wars (1977) and its two sequels.
David Prowse played Darth Vader in costume but did not provide his voice; Christopher Lee and Peter Cushing did not voice Vader.
David Prowse was a British bodybuilder.
James Earl Jones was not credited for voicing Vader in the original 1977 release of Star Wars.
